steps.content: [Black Screen + Purple Smoke]
Where am I?
Your consciousness is torn apart, then reassembles itself piece by piece. In the murk between states, it's the cold that finds you, one that mirrors the temperature of your own body.

You lie half-submerged in water, your soaked shirt clinging to skin, and the slightest shift stings like flesh peeling away, almost like... the water is boiling. And yet, a deep chill has settled inside you. Red light pulses and sways before your eyes, a vision caught somewhere between dream and delusion.
A strange, cloying fragrance wafts through the air, thick enough to choke on. From it, tendrils of violet smoke curl into a warped human shape and drift toward you, unhurried and near.

Several lances of blue light tear suddenly through it like a volley of bullets, blasting it apart into a mess of pulp that splatters into the water. And before you, veiled in haze, a black triangle takes shape.

steps.speaker: Blurry Black Triangle
steps.content: Chief... Chi...
You lack the strength to even answer. It simply hovers beside you, blue light still sweeping the darkness. Following the beam, you spot more indistinct shapes farther out. And then you see...

Crimson spikes spear up through the water, ripping aberrations limb from limb. Fragments of all sizes now drift on the surface. So you were fighting your own battle all along. How long has it been? Even your shackles have wearied, now capable only of gathering close, standing guard at your side.

steps.speaker: Twisted Shadow
steps.content: A heavy price... why is it him... wrong person... intercepted...
steps.female_content: A heavy price... why is it her... wrong person... intercepted...

steps.speaker: Twisted Shadow
steps.content: Careful. Were our faces seen? Shh, keep it down... we might be recognized... Just kill... kill...
Every strike cuts through nothing but smoke. Here, in this uncanny space, wrapped in curling incense, you have no way to tell substance from shadow.

steps.speaker: Twisted Shadow
steps.content: Don't worry. He's barely holding on... won't make it, can't get out. A <color=#fb9259>defective</color> one, after all...
steps.female_content: Don't worry. She's barely holding on... won't make it, can't get out. A <color=#fb9259>defective</color> one, after all...

steps.speaker: Twisted Shadow
steps.content: Just look... A defective thing worshipped by those Overground fools, fit only to mimic, never to touch true divinity...
Schorl, too, slowly falls silent. Along its polished surface, twisted crimson threads have taken root and spread. All blue light is unmade before it can coalesce, siphoned away.

In its final moment, it lowers itself, drawing close to you, still straining to convey something, but the red threads seal it shut. Finally, it is dragged beneath the surface into utter silence. Only chaotic, dark laughter coils around your ears.
Then, all at once, the world falls quiet. A voice rises from ahead. Frail, and yet startlingly clear.

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: ...There now. Mr. E won't be back for a while... Please, allow me to keep our guest company.

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: The fact that he's here at all... consider it a message from "god."
steps.female_content: The fact that she's here at all... consider it a message from "god."

steps.content: Her voice scatters the chaos. The cloying fragrance draws back, and your consciousness seeps back in.
[Barely Open Eyes] [Empty Scene]

This is not the Observation Hub. It's some other dimension, yet undeniably real. Beneath your feet, the submerged tiles burn. Lifting your gaze, you can just make out the pool's edge, where a set of steps climbs upward and vanishes into shadow.
You remember now. You pushed Lemma aside, tore into the puppet, and were swallowed by the fissure within its body. Looks like it's dragged you somewhere else. The Sillage Society, perhaps? Or...
Did Lemma's dimensional engineering pinpoint the Underground's entrance? The air here is loathsome, yet tinged with a familiarity you cannot name.
Something stirs across the water's surface, spreading as it dissolves the scattered debris piece by piece. It's... threads of blood, fine and seeking, like tendrils of dodder vine.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Who are you?

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: I am Sillage, the <color=#fb9259>Sage of Death</color>.

steps.speaker: Frail Voice
steps.content: Which, at the moment, I suppose... makes me your enemy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Like Adelaide. You're an Undergrounder...
[Release Shackles] Furious Questioning

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It was all you... BR-003... every Black Ring... the catastrophes, Mania... when does it end?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do you lunatics even want?! How many more have to die?!
She offers no answer to your frantic questions. You cannot see where she stands; you only feel the touch against one of your shackles, a contact that sends a tremor rippling through you.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: ...Shackles... How nostalgic...
[Entrance] [Back View] [Intersperse two nightmare images (no one in center)]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't—

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: Shh... It wouldn't be ideal to let them hear you.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: All I want is to take a look at you. That's all. Nothing else.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: ...So, we meet at last.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: How did you get in here? No one told me you would board the Ring. The sorcerers weren't after you either. You shouldn't have been pulled into this...

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: Did you force your way through the fissure with your shackles? Or did you somehow find new friends, even in a place like that?

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: I've heard you're always throwing yourself into the fire for them. Not exactly the best habit, I must say...
Her fingertips graze your wounds. The sting dissolves, your senses flood back, and to your bewilderment... her movements carry something strangely, impossibly gentle.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: I never meant for you to get tangled up in this. Stand down. Don't get yourself hurt. It's not time yet... This is not something worth going to war over.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: Or... we could make a deal. I have someone precious to me too. So, I need <color=#fb9259>BR-003</color>. Give it back to us.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: In return, I'll have a word with Mr. E. Keep his dogs on a shorter leash. I'll do what I can to spare your friends. How does that sound?
Every word of this bargain sickens you. Clarity has returned, and with it, your shackles strike, plunging through her body in one clean thrust. She, however, does not react.

Dodder vines swiftly creep over her wound, spiraling around your shackles. An indescribable dizziness overtakes you. You try to pull back, only to find that the shackles have already fused into her, leaving behind only a hollow.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: Even your tempers are alike... No matter. There's no rush.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: Little broken Shepherd... Since you won't hear me out, do keep yourself safe when you go back. Don't die too soon.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: ...I'd still like to see you two reunited. Dearest siblings, together at last...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You...

She lifts her eyes toward some point in the dark, and a smile crosses her face. Then, she pats your cheek gently before releasing you. You sink back into the water, suspended only by the finest dodder threads winding beneath the surface, still pumping something into your veins.

Already, she has turned her back, walking into the haze of purple smoke and strange fragrance. The wraithlike figures from afar erupt into exultant cries, chanting a name in frenzied worship, one utterly foreign to your ears.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: The lamb has been offered. Come forth, praise its name. Sillage shall guide you through the narrow gate; death shall ferry you into eternal life.
Mania seethes, rising in unison with the chant. The warped crimson mark on the woman's waist kindles before your eyes, blooming like a flower unfurling its petals. It makes even the shackles tremble.
She intones the chant, raising her cupped hands high, the water pooling in them like blood. Her gaze lifts toward the sky, heavy with expectation. And then, from the very point she watches...

Beams of laser tear through the smoke, stabbing directly into the pool and scattering water into the air. The ritual convulses and breaks. The gathered shadows flee in chaos, and there, suspended above, a familiar fissure rips open. Then you hear—

steps.speaker: Other Side
steps.content: <size=45>Now!</size>
In that very same breath, your shackles quiver with recognition. A familiar voice reaches your ears.

steps.speaker: Distant Voice
steps.content: Lemma, we good on the numbers? 'Cause I'm firing!

steps.speaker: Distant Voice
steps.content: Hang tight, Chief! Backup's inbound. Here comes the big climax!
Ah... At last, the world before you sharpens into clarity. Your heartbeat finds its rhythm again, and you know with absolute certainty what must be done.
[Release the shackles]

The water around you is hurled aside. A sphere that spans two meters blooms around you, the black triangle at its heart. Inside, space splinters into countless fractured layers, and you feel your own body beginning to come apart with it.
But someone has already traced the shackles to you, locking on with unerring precision. Arms wrap around your waist from behind, pulling tight. You glance back, and it's exactly who you thought—

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The hero has arrived!
